title: Asymptotic Analysis of Nonsymmetric Gaussian and Archimedean Compound Means
summary: This paper studies asymptotic expansions of the Gaussian and Archimedean compounds of two arbitrary bivariate means that need not be symmetric. Recursive algorithms for the coefficients of such expansions were previously obtained only in the symmetric case. Here, this restriction is removed and recursions are derived for the general nonsymmetric setting. All coefficient calculations are carried out in the algebra of formal power series.
